catalog: Western Heart — Blender / animation / modeling / clothes / accessory open-source sweep

gpu_packages.note: Packages for PARENT browser/GPU execution. No GPU job is claimed to have run in this sweep — no nvidia-smi, torch.cuda, render, or timing output exists yet. A speedup is MEASURED only after a CPU baseline and a GPU run of the same job both exist.

package_a_preview_renders.cpu_fallback: Same command with CPU device; local CPU only when GPU is unavailable.
package_a_preview_renders.gpu_command_shape: blender -b scene.blend -E CYCLES --cycles-device CUDA (or OPTIX on RTX) -o out/ -f 1
package_a_preview_renders.inputs: GLB/registry entry + lighting preset (studio/living_room/night) + camera take (from FreeCamera.saveTake() JSON)
package_a_preview_renders.job: Closet + scene preview renders (Cycles, headless Blender)
proof_required: wall time CPU baseline (same scene, --cycles-device NONE)
measured speedup = CPU wall / GPU wall (only after both exist)

package_b_retargets.inputs: Base character export + WH rig bone map + closet fit-rule checklist
package_b_retargets.job: Base-character retargets (MPFB2/CharMorph/MB-Lab base -> WH rig, weight/Data Transfer)
package_b_retargets.note: Weight transfer itself is CPU work in Blender; GPU claims apply to the render/preview steps of the same job, not to the transfer. Do not inflate a render speedup into a retarget speedup.
proof_required: nvidia-smi output where a GPU step is used (viewport/render steps; pure Blender weight transfer is CPU — say so, do not claim GPU speedup for a CPU step)

rule: License AS STATED by the source, never relabeled. Paid/proprietary tools are in reference_only, never in the open-source list. Copyleft (GPL/AGPL) is DOCUMENTED, never a block (user override: license firewall OFF for pulling). Nothing here counts as 'wired' or 'in the closet' until it is refit to the target rig and renders clean full-body AND part-zoomed (closet fit rule). URLs were verified by git ls-remote HEAD or by a returned search result before citing; entries marked url_unverified carry NO clone URL — resolve it before pulling, do not guess one.
